### The New Heavens and Earth
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/new-heavens-and-earth
Passage: Isaiah 65:17-20
Points:
- Isaiah offers the Bible's first explicit reference to a renewed cosmos affecting the whole world.
- Christ’s redemptive work secures an eternal home suited for those declared righteous in Him.
- In the new creation, sorrow will vanish, and God will delight in His restored people.
- The renewal was inaugurated through Christ's resurrection and will reach completion at His return.
- The certain hope that God will set all things right enables believers to endure present pain.
